class_evidence.ask_mechanism: No ask rule changes. Once the gated anaphor uniquely resolves, ordinary relation saturation derives the multiplied distance and then the measured offset distance in successive rounds. The existing ask/how-many-combined-named consumer sums exactly the requested holders and declines if either remains unresolved.
class_evidence.premise_mechanism: The specialized DIFG rule emits the reserved quantity-anaphor standard plus literal registry gates: antecedent measure must be length_measure and antecedent Quantity.verb must be motion_comparison_verb. Registry compilation rejects unknown, templated, or wrong-rooted gate categories. Saturation filters all earlier Quantities by those gates and asks deixis.constant for a unique winner among compatible candidates only. Thus apples, hours, dollars, years, and state-held miles cannot anchor distance; an incompatible quantity does not compete with one compatible distance; two compatible distances still decline. The generic amount/number anaphor and its verb guard remain unchanged.
structural_summary: A reserved anaphoric Relation may declaratively name admissible antecedent measure and verb categories.
Category filtering occurs before constant-metric uniqueness, so incompatible facts neither win nor create false ambiguity.
No compatible antecedent or multiple compatible antecedents both decline; resolution never uses recency.
The distance rule requires a length-denominated Quantity governed by a motion-comparison verb, closing count, duration, currency, calendar, and state-length collisions.
A following measured linear comparison adds a signed length offset, after which the existing exact named-pair total can answer.
The runtime evidence, fingerprint, and traces come from the declared gsm8k project; curated owns only the central evidence queue.

implementation_contract.class_justification: This is one vertical semantic class: a distance-specific motion multiplier feeds a measured motion offset and the existing combined total. The repair is general rather than word-specific Python: Relation exposes optional category names, the registry validates their roots, and saturation applies them uniformly to any quantity-anaphor rule that opts in. Existing rules default to no gates and retain their behavior. The premise rules are DIFG-owned because distance and farther are DIFG-owned. The only historical test drift changes the GSM full-registry premise count from 121 to 123. Both candidate commits were replayed unchanged onto exact base 1c785cb4c477df41dbba79ff02efd9f97f3af1b4.

mechanism: Relation carries optional declarative anaphor antecedent measure and verb categories. The general quantity-anaphor resolver filters earlier Quantities through every declared gate before applying its existing constant-metric unique resolution; it never chooses by recency. The DIFG distance sibling declares length_measure and motion_comparison_verb, so only a unique earlier motion distance can anchor it. The measured farther rule then emits the ordinary offset Relation, and existing fixpoint saturation plus the existing combined-named ask finish the chain. This revision is replayed onto base 1c785cb4c477df41dbba79ff02efd9f97f3af1b4.
risks: The shared quantity-anaphor sentinel is measure-agnostic by default; every semantically specialized anaphor must explicitly emit relevant category gates. Existing generic amount/number/much/many rules intentionally retain their historical ungated contract.
A measure-only gate would still let a state-held length anchor a motion event; the distance rule also requires the antecedent Quantity verb to be motion_comparison_verb.
Filtering must precede uniqueness: incompatible facts are excluded, while two compatible motion distances remain ambiguous and decline under deixis.constant without recency selection.
A broad comparative admission could treat age, time, mass, or arbitrary objects as distance; farther remains limited to linear measured categories and counted length compatibility.
An unresolved gated Relation must not be ignored by an answer; negative synthetic neighbours assert no derived Bira quantity and an ordinary decline.
Necessary pack scope: both premise rules live in a DIFG rule file because curated must not load unreachable rules whose required identities are DIFG-owned.
Necessary general-kernel scope: model.py carries declarative gate fields, registry.py validates their category contracts, and saturate.py filters candidates before unchanged uniqueness resolution.
Necessary mechanical test drift: GSM full-registry inventory increases only from 121 to 123; blocker assertions remain unchanged.
Runtime provenance is explicit: runtime_project gsm8k produced this manifest fingerprint and every canonical trace; curated is not represented as the candidate runtime.
